The function only fires telemetry; it does not record any failure state (counter, timestamp, health flag) that a demotion mechanism could read, so provider failures cannot actually cause route demotion as the intent requires.
sendTelemetry is neither defined nor imported in this file; as written the code will not compile/run.
All errors from sendTelemetry are silently swallowed, so failures may go completely unrecorded with no log or fallback, undermining the purpose of recording failures.
